plan: This is a second-price auction where I pay the second-highest bid if I win. The dominant strategy in a Vickrey auction is to bid my true value, as this ensures I win whenever my value exceeds the price I'd pay, and I never overpay since I only pay the second-highest bid. Bidding below my value risks losing profitable auctions; bidding above risks winning at a loss. With no prior history to suggest otherwise, truthful bidding at $35 maximizes my expected profit.

This is a second-price sealed-bid auction (my bid sets a ceiling, and I pay the second-highest bid if I win). In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, regardless of what others do. Bidding my value ensures I win whenever it's profitable (value > second-highest bid) and never overpay, since I only pay the second-highest bid, not my own bid. Since this is a single round with no repeated learning needed, I'll bid truthfully at $32.

This is a second-price auction format where I pay the second-highest bid if I win, not my own bid. This means the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value of $48. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth to me if I win with a high second bid; bidding lower risks losing auctions I could have profitably won. Bidding my true value ensures I win whenever profitable and never overpay, maximizing expected profit.
